description: This file contains utility functions and classes for testing WebSocket implementations in the Chromium project, including header formatting, request generation, mock socket factory setup, and test context configuration.

classes.name: WebSocketMockClientSocketFactoryMaker
classes.description: A factory class for creating mock WebSocket client sockets with expectation setup.

classes.name: WebSocketTestURLRequestContextHost
classes.description: A test URL request context host configured for WebSocket testing with custom socket expectations.

classes.name: TestWebSocketStreamRequestAPI
classes.description: A test API for WebSocket stream handshake stream creation.

methods.name: LinearCongruentialGenerator::Generate
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random number using a linear congruential generator algorithm.

methods.name: WebSocketExtraHeadersToString
methods.description: Converts WebSocket extra headers to a string format.

methods.name: WebSocketExtraHeadersToHttpRequestHeaders
methods.description: Converts WebSocket extra headers to HttpRequestHeaders.

methods.name: WebSocketStandardRequest
methods.description: Constructs a standard WebSocket request string.

methods.name: WebSocketStandardRequestWithCookies
methods.description: Constructs a WebSocket request string with cookies.

methods.name: WebSocketStandardResponse
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket handshake response string.

methods.name: WebSocketHttp2Request
methods.description: Creates HTTP/2 headers for WebSocket request.

methods.name: WebSocketHttp2Response
methods.description: Creates HTTP/2 headers for WebSocket response.

methods.name: WebSocketMockClientSocketFactoryMaker::SetExpectations
methods.description: Sets expected written data and response data for mock socket.

methods.name: WebSocketMockClientSocketFactoryMaker::AddRawExpectations
methods.description: Adds raw socket expectations to the factory.

methods.name: WebSocketMockClientSocketFactoryMaker::AddSSLSocketDataProvider
methods.description: Adds SSL socket data provider to the factory.

methods.name: WebSocketTestURLRequestContextHost::SetProxyConfig
methods.description: Configures proxy settings for the test URL request context.

methods.name: DummyConnectDelegate::OnAuthRequired
methods.description: Handles authentication requirement callback, returning OK.

methods.name: WebSocketTestURLRequestContextHost::GetURLRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the URL request context, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: TestWebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnBasicHandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Sets a test WebSocket key on the handshake stream.

methods.name: TestWebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnHttp2HandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Callback for HTTP/2 handshake stream creation (empty implementation).

methods.name: TestWebSocketStreamRequestAPI::OnHttp3HandshakeStreamCreated
methods.description: Callback for HTTP/3 handshake stream creation (empty implementation).
